cases.name: zero credit is the empty basket

hints: Why would [2, 3, 3] and [3, 2, 3] both show up if you try every next item? How can you forbid going back?
Backtracking with a start index over a sorted menu.
Sort the prices; recurse with (start = i, left = left − price) so an item can repeat but nothing earlier is chosen, record when left is 0, and break when a price exceeds left.

signals: Explains how the start index prevents duplicate orderings of one basket
Recurses with i (not i + 1) because reuse is allowed
Sorts and prunes once a price exceeds the remaining credit
Copies the basket when recording a result
Distinguishes listing baskets (search) from counting them (DP)
